title: Concept: App Transport Security disabled for arbitrary loads in swift — review required
description: In swift, App Transport Security is disabled globally. ATS exists to make plaintext and outdated TLS fail closed; the arbitrary-loads key reopens both for every connection the app makes, including third-party SDK traffic the team may not have enumerated. A global switch is rarely what the failing host actually needed.
applicability: swift iOS applications that call remote services.
risk: Plaintext and downgraded TLS connections; MEDIUM severity.
